definitions.window: 20 bins x 100 ns over the full stored 2 us trace (raw samples 0-999 at 500 MS/s); paper's 1 us = bins 0-9
definitions.start_L: filtered Viterbi state equals L in both bins 1 and 2 (100-300 ns); bin 0 is ring-up
definitions.soft_pi_L_t0: HMM posterior P(L) at bin 0 averaged over shots (one-step M-step estimate of the initial distribution)
definitions.mid_entry_L: shot started in |0> or |1> and enters L at bin >= 3 within the window (filtered Viterbi)
definitions.tau: HMM: per-100 ns exit probability from frozen-TRAIN posteriors on TEST, delta-method CI; Viterbi: censored-geometric MLE, Clopper-Pearson CI
definitions.null_MA1_false_positive: same pipeline on synthetic shots from the fitted model with L switched off and MA(1) noise matched to the measured lag-1 correlation
definitions.denominators: TEST: 560000 shots per prepared bit per qubit; pooled 1120000
